context: Adds ConfigureAwait(false) to a service call inside an MVC controller action that runs on the classic ASP.NET (System.Web) synchronization context and reads HttpContext after the await.
explanation: ConfigureAwait(false) tells the continuation not to resume on the captured synchronization context. On classic ASP.NET (System.Web), that context is what carries HttpContext.Current; resuming on a thread-pool thread instead means the code after the await can find HttpContext.Current null or, under concurrent requests, referring to the wrong request entirely. Fix: do not use ConfigureAwait(false) in request-handling code that touches HttpContext after an await — let it resume on the captured context.
